title: Gadget Zone – HOT PICK floating button + bottom HOT PICK Motorola section (SEO, image, GA4 tracking)

requirements.summary: Update the floating HOT PICK button label and behavior to smoothly scroll to the bottom HOT PICK section while remaining fixed-position.
acceptanceCriteria: A floating button is visible above page content and does not change layout/position based on sections (fixed positioning).
Button text is exactly "🔥 HOT PICK".
Clicking the button performs smooth scrolling to the HOT PICK section at the bottom of the page.

file_operations.description: Update the floating action button label text to exactly "🔥 HOT PICK" and keep fixed FAB styling/positioning (not section-sticky).
Wire HotFab onClick to smoothly scroll to the dedicated bottom-of-page HOT PICK section (using a ref or section id) without affecting other sections.

requirements.summary: Track GA4 clicks on the floating HOT PICK button with event name "hot_pick_click" and page_url parameter, safely no-oping when GA4 is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Each HOT PICK button click triggers a GA4 event named "hot_pick_click" when GA4 is available.
If GA4 is unavailable, clicking the button still scrolls and the app does not error.
Event parameters include page_url = current window.location.href.

file_operations.description: On HOT PICK FAB click, send a GA4 event named "hot_pick_click" with page_url set to window.location.href using the existing safe GA4 wrapper (must not throw if GA4 is unavailable).
(If needed) confirm sendGA4Event usage covers the required parameters and remains safe/no-op when GA4 is unavailable; avoid breaking existing tracking behavior.

requirements.summary: Add/update a dedicated bottom-of-page HOT PICK content section with the exact required title and ensure it is always rendered last on the page.
acceptanceCriteria: A HOT PICK section exists at the bottom of the page (last major section rendered in the app).
The section title text is exactly "🔥 HOT PICK – Latest Motorola Signature Smartphone".

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated HOT PICK section component that renders the exact title text "🔥 HOT PICK – Latest Motorola Signature Smartphone" and exposes a stable anchor/ref target for smooth scrolling.
Render the HOT PICK section component as the last major section in the App layout (bottom of the page) and connect the scroll target (ref/id) used by the floating button.

requirements.summary: Render the user-provided SEO text verbatim in the HOT PICK section and add a separate natural keyword paragraph without altering the verbatim block.
acceptanceCriteria: The provided body text appears in the HOT PICK section exactly as written by the user (including line breaks/paragraph separation and bullet characters "•").

The HOT PICK section also includes the keywords: "Motorola mobile phone", "Motorola Signature phone", "Latest Motorola phone", "Motorola phone price in Chennai", "Buy Motorola phone near me", and "Motorola mobile store in Thiruvanmiyur" in a natural-sounding way (e.g., in an additional short paragraph within the same section).
No other page sections’ text content is changed as part of this update.

file_operations.description: Implement the HOT PICK body content rendering using a verbatim multi-line block that preserves wording, punctuation, paragraph breaks, and the "•" bullets exactly as provided; add an additional short paragraph within the same section to naturally include the specified Motorola-related keywords without modifying the verbatim block.

requirements.summary: Add Call and WhatsApp enquiry CTAs directly below the HOT PICK content using existing phone/WhatsApp numbers and existing CTA styling patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Two buttons/CTAs are visible below the HOT PICK text: Call and WhatsApp.
Call uses a tel: link for the existing phone number already used elsewhere in the app.
WhatsApp uses a wa.me (or equivalent) link for the existing WhatsApp number already used elsewhere in the app.
These additions do not remove or change existing call/WhatsApp CTAs in other sections.

file_operations.description: Add two CTA buttons directly below the HOT PICK text: Call (tel:+919840077591) and WhatsApp (https://wa.me/919840077591), using the app’s existing Button styling patterns and keeping existing CTAs elsewhere unchanged.

requirements.summary: Add and render a static photorealistic Motorola product image in the HOT PICK section from generated assets using existing image conventions.
acceptanceCriteria: The HOT PICK section displays a single product-style image meeting the specified constraints (white/transparent background; no lifestyle background; phone(s) centered and clearly the focus; premium clean photoshoot look).
The image is served as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated (not fetched via backend).
The image is rendered using the app’s existing image rendering conventions (e.g., SafeImage or equivalent) and does not break layout on mobile/desktop.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static HOT PICK product image asset at this exact path for use in the HOT PICK section.

Render the HOT PICK product image using the existing SafeImage component and existing product-section visual patterns; reference the static asset frontend/public/assets/generated/hot-pick-motorola-signature.dim_1200x900.png and ensure responsive layout for mobile/desktop.

requirements.summary: Keep the update isolated to only the HOT PICK floating button and the bottom HOT PICK section, preserving all other sections’ layout and behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing sections (hero, services, tracking initialization, other CTAs, and existing HOT details behavior) continue to function as before.
No unintended spacing/positioning regressions occur in other sections across mobile and desktop breakpoints.
HOT PICK section remains the last section on the page after changes.

file_operations.description: Limit changes to: (1) HotFab wiring/handler and (2) appending the new/updated HOT PICK bottom section as the final section; avoid modifying other section content/structure beyond minimal integration.
Ensure only the label/ARIA text and click behavior expectations are updated, keeping the component’s fixed floating behavior intact and not impacting other UI components.
